frozen_at: 2026-09-10 after consumed fresh30 diagnosis and before any candidate5000 target inference
scientific_hypothesis: A query-conditioned partial order over lossless evidence packets, followed by a separately learned monotone prefix budget, can approximate the optimal fidelity-constrained nested subset trajectory more reliably than absolute packet reveal thresholds.

consumed_diagnostic.status: development evidence only; never a new heldout result
consumed_diagnostic.finding: cutoff is primary failure; learned ordering is imperfect but promising

preserved_invariants.target_decoding: single-pass greedy, thinking disabled, 256 new tokens
preserved_invariants.representation: one nested prefix trajectory shared across fidelity levels

candidate_pool.whitespace_normalization: collapse internal proof whitespace only; no word deletion or rewriting
candidate_pool.eligibility_after_exact: maximum any-state fidelity >= 0.90; full-state fidelity is not a filter

target_blind_candidate_partitions.failure_rule: If any partition is short, stop and use only a separately frozen role-specific reserve; never move target-observed examples between roles.

exact_oracle.objective: minimum cumulative tokens over complete nested chains satisfying active fidelity anchors
exact_oracle.supervision: partial-order pairs identifiable across the complete near-optimal chain set
exact_oracle.ambiguous_pairs: ignored, not assigned an arbitrary single-chain order
exact_oracle.robust_never_reveal: excluded from every admissible terminal state

ranking_model.head: shared MLP score over local packet mean hidden plus global final hidden
ranking_model.loss: example-balanced RankNet logistic loss over identifiable partial-order pairs
ranking_model.checkpoint_selection: minimum pairwise loss on fixed ranking_validation300

ranking_only_gate_before_cutoff.primary: learned order plus global oracle monotone cutoff
ranking_only_gate_before_cutoff.decision: Only a conjunctive pass permits implementation or training of the cutoff head.

cutoff_and_risk_stage_if_ranking_passes.cutoff: monotone token-aware prefix budget head; terminal cutoff may be smaller than 12
cutoff_and_risk_stage_if_ranking_passes.risk_statement: per-anchor one-sided Clopper-Pearson bounds with Bonferroni familywise alpha 0.05

primary_metrics: oracle-cutoff prefix feasibility and contract success
robust never-reveal and robust harmful precision/recall

nonprimary_metrics.NDCG: secondary only after a set-valued graded relevance definition is frozen
